glossary.def: A standalone page in this guide: mechanism, where and when to use it, alternatives, pitfalls, scenario cards, quick checks and flashcards.
A short situation with fixed constraints, open unknowns and options that each carry a verdict, a reason and a trade-off.
The label on a scenario option: **best** fits every stated constraint, **good** is acceptable with a cost, **poor** fails a constraint or adds cost the constraints do not need.
A setting that shows quiz and model answers with an Answer key badge. Turn it on only on the host's screen in a group session.
One of five review levels for flashcards. A card moves up when you recall it and back when you do not.
The stack a question travels through, from the model call to knowledge, tools, agents, proof and operations, used to place a problem on a layer.
A feature or model that still works but has an announced end date.
A feature or model that has stopped working after its end date.

claims.text: OpenAI released the Responses API with built-in tools on 2025-03-11.
Azure OpenAI v1 API is opt-in since August 2025, uses a base URL ending /openai/v1 and needs no api-version.
The Conversations API was released on 2025-08-20 and is not ZDR eligible.
OpenAI announced Assistants API deprecation on 2025-08-26 and sunset it on 2026-08-26.
From GPT-5.4, Chat Completions does not support tool calling with reasoning_effort other than none.
Azure gpt-5.6-sol fails with 'Function tools with reasoning_effort are not supported' on Chat Completions even when effort is omitted, because the default is medium.
Claude Opus 4.7 (2026-04-16) uses a new tokenizer that yields about 30% more tokens and returns 400 for non-default sampling values.
GPT-6 Astra was released on 2026-09-03 and rejects reasoning.effort none with HTTP 400.
GPT-6.1 Sol was released on 2026-09-29 and needs Responses for tools; Chat Completions works only without tools.
Claude Opus 5.5 (2026-09-22) cannot disable thinking, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (2026-09-28) returns 400 for forced tool_choice.
OpenAI released client-side /responses/compact on 2025-12-11 and server-side compaction with context_management on 2026-02-10.
GPT-5.6 caching bills cache writes at 1.25x input on OpenAI and adds prompt_cache_options and explicit breakpoints; older models return 400 for the new fields.
Prompt Cache Diagnostics reached GA in Responses for GPT-5.6 and later on 2026-09-08.
On 2026-05-07 OpenAI began winding down self-serve fine-tuning, and active customers can no longer create jobs after 2027-01-06.
OpenAI deprecated the Evals platform, reusable prompts and Agent Builder on 2026-06-03: Evals read-only on 2026-10-31 and shutdown of all three on 2026-11-30.
OpenAI shuts down gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo, o1, o3-mini, o4-mini and gpt-4.1-nano on 2026-10-23.
Azure retires o1, o3 and o4-mini on 2026-11-19.
Azure retires gpt-4o version 2024-05-13 on 2026-12-09 and the gpt-4.1 family on 2027-04-14.
gpt-5 snapshots shut down on the OpenAI API on 2026-12-11 while Azure retires gpt-5 on 2027-02-09.
Azure Flex requests to a model without Flex support return 400 instead of falling back to Standard (2026-09-25).
MCP 2025-03-26 replaced HTTP+SSE with Streamable HTTP and added the OAuth 2.1 framework.
MCP 2025-06-18 made servers OAuth resource servers, required RFC 8707 resource indicators from clients and removed JSON-RPC batching.
MCP 2025-11-25 added URL elicitation and experimental Tasks.
MCP moved under the Agentic AI Foundation on 2025-12-09.
A2A v1.0.0 was published on 2026-03-12 and v1.0.1 on 2026-05-28.

MCP 2026-07-28 removes initialize and the session id, replaces server-initiated requests with multi round-trip requests, deprecates sampling and roots, moves Tasks to an extension and makes tools/list ordering deterministic.
With no version header or query value, Foundry serves A2A preview 0.3, and the header and query value must agree or the call returns 400.
Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 was announced on 2026-04-03 with the hosting, A2A, DevUI and AG-UI packages still preview.
Microsoft Agent 365 reached GA on 2026-05-01, licensed per user.
Support for the initial-preview Foundry hosted agent backend ended on 2026-08-20.
Foundry Workflows (preview) retire on 2026-12-01.
The 2026-04-01 AI Search stable API makes index projections and the Content Understanding skill GA, and its agentic retrieval is limited to minimal extractive retrieval.
Azure OpenAI On Your Data retires on 2026-10-14.
The EU Digital Omnibus on AI is in force (2026-07-27) and moves Annex III high-risk obligations to 2027-12-02 and Annex I to 2028-08-02.
Anthropic advises finding the simplest solution possible and adding complexity only when needed, because agentic systems trade latency and cost for performance.
